meta.title: Logic test — challenge your thinking
meta.description: Logic questions on numbers, patterns and spatial thinking. Get your result as a score, a percentage and a level.

home.subtitle: Find the rules hidden in numbers, patterns and shapes. Every question is a small puzzle, and the result gives you a clear picture of how you think.
home.how_subtitle: Three simple steps — no sign-up forms and no waiting.

steps.title: {count} questions
steps.text: Each question has a picture or a number sequence and 6 options. You pick one.

steps.title: {minutes} minutes
steps.text: The timer runs on the server. If the page reloads, the test continues where you left off.

steps.title: Detailed result
steps.text: Score, percentage, level and a breakdown across three areas. A certificate and a share card.

numeric.title: Numerical logic
numeric.text: Finding the relationship between numbers and the rule of a sequence.

pattern.title: Patterns and sequences
pattern.text: Seeing how shapes change from one step to the next.

spatial.title: Spatial thinking
spatial.text: Mentally rotating, flipping and assembling shapes.

home.final_text: Find a quiet place, set aside {minutes} minutes and begin.
home.disclaimer: The result is given as a score, a percentage and a level. The test is not normed, so it does not produce an IQ number.

start.title: Before you start
start.subtitle: Enter your name — it will appear on your result and certificate.
rules: Only one answer can be chosen per question
Time limit — {minutes} minutes; when time runs out the test finishes automatically
You can change answers and move between questions at any time
Scores and correct answers are not shown during the test
start.keyboard: Keyboard: 1–6 or A–F — choose an option, ← → — questions
start.telegram_filled: Name taken from your Telegram profile
start.resume_text: You can continue your previous attempt from where you left off.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.generic: Could not start the test. Check your internet connection and try again.

start.name_locked: Your name is saved to your Telegram account. If it is wrong, contact the administrator.
start.name_first_time: Enter your real full name — it will appear on the certificate and cannot be changed later.

test.question: Question {n}
test.offline: No connection — answers will be resent
test.finish_all: You have answered every question. Once you finish, answers cannot be changed.

finish_unanswered.one: {n} question is unanswered. An unanswered question scores 0.
finish_unanswered.other: {n} questions are unanswered. An unanswered question scores 0.

test.timeup_text: The test finished automatically. Your result is being calculated.
test.not_found_text: This test was started on another device or the link is wrong. Start a new test.
test.load_error_text: Check your internet connection and try again.

result.title: Your result
result.expired_note: The test finished automatically because time ran out.
result.categories_hint: Relative to the maximum score in each area
result.share_text: I scored {score} / {max} on the Logic test — {level}! Try it yourself:
result.disclaimer: This result is not an IQ number: the test is not normed. The result is given only as a score, a percentage and a level.
result.not_found_text: The result is only visible on the device where the test was taken.
result.no_certificate: No certificate is issued at this stage. Invite friends and unlock the certificate stage!

errors.not_found_text: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

auth.title: Sign in with Telegram
auth.text: Your results are saved to your Telegram account and visible from any device. No password needed.
auth.widget_hint: Press the button and confirm in Telegram
auth.error: Could not sign in. Please try again.
auth.unavailable: Signing in with Telegram is not set up yet.
auth.or_bot: or open the test directly in the Telegram bot

me.title: My results
me.subtitle: All attempts linked to your Telegram account
me.empty_text: Take your first test — the result will appear here.

verify.title: Verify a certificate
verify.valid_text: The data below comes straight from the server. If the name, score or level on the certificate in your hands differs from this, the certificate has been altered (forged).
verify.invalid_text: This verification code does not exist or the test is not finished yet. Check that you copied the code correctly from the certificate.
verify.name: Full name
verify.enter_text: The code is printed at the bottom of the certificate, next to the QR code.

stages.title: Choose a stage
stages.subtitle: Questions are picked at random in every stage. The certificate is awarded at the final stage.
stages.channels_text: To start the test, join the channels below and then press “Check”.

stages.friends_text: Send the link to your friends. A friend counts once they open the bot and join the channels.
